verdict.rationale: Shortcut's own Automations feature handles recurring routine work: it auto-creates future Iterations, rolls unfinished Stories into the next Iteration, and auto-starts or auto-completes Epics. These look like fixed, preset automations rather than workflows an engineer builds with custom schedules or triggers. The REST API is only a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a user-defined workflow or automation builder, configurable schedule/cron or arbitrary recurring-event triggers, detailed first-party docs on automation configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work

citations.quote: Automations Auto-start and auto-complete an Epic, auto-create future Iterations, and move unfinished Stories to the next Iteration
